decisions.reason: The extended trial batch already requires compliance with the Notion brand guidelines. The source adds a specific content-selection exclusion to the separate source-selection Requirement but does not change the batch's clip count, source content, acceptance standard, or scope.
The source explicitly concerns work beyond the completed initial Upwork trial and does not revise the initial three-clip batch or its acceptance condition.

The source instructs the freelancer to review the guidelines, including their hook guidance, but does not establish a new or changed hook-quality rule. The existing effective-hook requirement remains valid unchanged.
The reference to editing style identifies material to review but does not specify a change to the existing clean-editing standard.
